risk_matrix.risk_description: Local synthetic E2E evidence stays within in-memory records and does not require DB, Supabase, migration execution or real source connection.
risk_matrix.mitigation: Keep records synthetic/local, require explicit shadowOutcome metadata, and preserve all authority flags false.

risk_matrix.risk_description: Migration validation path may drift toward infrastructure unless separately constrained as non-productive/no-op.
risk_matrix.mitigation: Require explicit no-op/non-productive validation path design before any migration validation attempt.

risk_matrix.risk_description: Holding preserves authority but delays available local integration evidence.
risk_matrix.mitigation: Use only if local E2E evidence becomes impossible without physical schema.
